
---
title: "Lyrics"
---

```{r}
source("data_prep.R")

library(htmltools)
library(tidyverse)

# Find all lyric files, including those in subfolders
lyrics_files <- list.files(
  "song_lyrics",
  pattern = "\\.(csv|txt)$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

# Match filenames to trax sort values
lyrics_index <- tibble(
  sort = suppressWarnings(as.integer(
    tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(lyrics_files))
  )),
  file = lyrics_files
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sort)) %>%
  inner_join(
    df %>% distinct(sort, songname, artist, cdseq, `album name`),
    by = "sort"
  ) %>%
  arrange(sort) %>%
  distinct(sort, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Create a section for each song with available lyrics
lyric_sections <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(lyrics_index)), function(i) {
  song <- lyrics_index[i, ]

  # Read the file as plain text, not as a CSV table
lyric_lines <- readLines(
  song$file,
  warn = FALSE,
  encoding = ""
)

# Convert to valid UTF-8, removing invalid byte sequences
lyric_lines <- iconv(
  lyric_lines,
  from = "",
  to = "UTF-8",
  sub = ""
)

  # Remove a simple "lyrics" heading if present
  if (length(lyric_lines) > 0 &&
      trimws(lyric_lines[1]) == "lyrics") {
    lyric_lines <- lyric_lines[-1]
  }

  # Join lines while preserving blank lines
  text <- paste(lyric_lines, collapse = "\n")

  # Convert HTML <br> tags to line breaks
  text <- gsub(
    "<br\\s*/?>",
    "\n",
    text,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  # Decode HTML entities such as &quot; and &amp;
  text <- xml2::xml_text(
    xml2::read_html(
      paste0("<html><body><div>", text, "</div></body></html>")
    )
  )

  # Normalize line endings
  text <- gsub("\r\n?", "\n", text)

  # Normalize unusual whitespace characters
  text <- gsub("\u00A0", " ", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("\u202F", " ", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("\u200B", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("\t+", " ", text)

  # Remove spaces at the ends of lines
  text <- gsub("[ \t]+\n", "\n", text)
  text <- gsub("\n[ \t]+", "\n", text)

  # Collapse repeated spaces within each line,
  # while preserving line breaks and stanza spacing
  lines <- strsplit(text, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lines <- gsub(" {2,}", " ", lines)
  text <- paste(lines, collapse = "\n")

  # Reduce excessive blank lines but retain stanza breaks
  text <- gsub("\n{3,}", "\n\n", text)

  # Remove whitespace at the beginning and end
  text <- trimws(text)

  tags$section(
    id = paste0("lyrics-", song$sort),
    class = "lyrics-section",
    tags$h2(as.character(song$songname)),
    tags$p(
      class = "lyrics-meta",
      paste(
        as.character(song$artist),
        "—",
        as.character(song$`album name`)
      )
    ),
    tags$pre(class = "lyrics-text", text),
    tags$p(
      tags$a(
        href = paste0("albums.html#album-", song$cdseq),
        "Back to album"
      )
    )
  )
})

htmltools::browsable(
  tags$div(
    tags$p(paste(nrow(lyrics_index), "songs with lyrics")),
    lyric_sections
  )
)
```
